title: First 100 medium-machine candidates: facsimile headword/boundary review
provenance_note: AI-assisted visual collation against the supplied Steffel facsimile. This is the first medium-confidence cohort after complete exhaustion of the high-machine tier. The cohort lies in the German→Rarámuri dictionary and spans printed pp. 301–308. Review covers headword presence, article-start boundary and exact printed page; it is not independent linguistic validation. The facsimile is authoritative, and the supplied OCR is used only as a secondary reading aid. Because medium-confidence candidates disproportionately arise from wrapped glosses and explanatory prose, false-positive rejection is expected to be higher than in the high-confidence tier.
